// Guard fixture: an unregistered current-score read of the bare table.
//
// The go tool ignores testdata/, so this file is parsed by the guard and
// never compiled. That is the point: it can hold the exact broken shape
// the guard exists to catch, permanently, instead of the shape existing
// only while someone edits a real file.
//
// The doc comment below deliberately names host_rule_state so the
// fixture also proves comments are not part of the population.

package fixture

// ScoreHost reads host_rule_state without scoping it, which is the
// twelfth read site this guard exists to find.
func ScoreHost(hostID string) string {
	return `
		SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_status = 'pass'), COUNT(*)
		  FROM host_rule_state
		 WHERE host_id = $1`
}
